method: Separate bounded attribution probes, never acceptance. Sampling includes objects collected by minor/major GC at 32768-byte intervals; cumulative estimates are not retained memory or physical peaks. No forced GC or heap snapshot.
decision: The current DOM native-selection step has an observed renderer-only cost above 32 MiB even with main excluded. Do not remove it from Full or change the threshold. A different exact-text rendering surface needs a bounded feasibility prototype and accessibility/selection approval.
